title: November 9 to 15, 2026
summary: A quieter week: page descriptions now fit in search results, and two fixes for keyboard and screen reader users in Browse and the collection.

improved.title: Descriptions in search results
improved.body: Every page's description now fits within what search engines show, so a search result for a card, a playstyle or an ink page no longer cuts its description off partway.

fixed.title: Keyboard focus in the collection's menu
fixed.body: Pressing Tab out of the collection's open gear menu now closes it and puts focus back on the gear button, instead of losing focus with the menu.

fixed.title: The Filters button for screen readers
fixed.body: Screen readers and voice control now read the Filters button the way it looks, with a space between the word and the count of filters on, instead of running them together.

behindTheScenes: Plus 10 behind-the-scenes changes: dependency updates, design cleanups, a fix for the admin tools, and work on features that aren't switched on yet.
